data.gender_notes: Iyla is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Iyla is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Chandra', which means moon. In Hindu mythology, the moon god is often personified as a goddess, and Iyla is believed to represent the feminine aspect of the moon. The name Iyla carries the meaning “Moon Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Iyla usually hope their child will grow to embody moon goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with the grace and tranquility of the moon goddess.
data.etymology: Iyla belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon Goddess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iyla total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
